Educate | Elevate | Engage

WORTH Association is Canada's community for women building careers in recreation, tourism and hospitality. Mentorship, learning, scholarships and a network of 1,200+ members from coast to coast.

Now matching: the Winter 2027 Mentorship cohort. Applications close January 15, members are paired with senior leaders across hotels, resorts, attractions and destination organizations.

Our Purpose

Hospitality runs on women. Leadership should too.

Women make up the majority of the tourism and hospitality workforce in Canada, yet remain underrepresented in its executive suites, ownership groups and boardrooms.

WORTH exists to close that gap. We connect women at every stage of their careers with the mentors, skills, funding and community that turn a job in hospitality into a lifetime of leadership, and we work with employers who are ready to do their part.

The Member Journey

Wherever you are in your career, there is a next step, and women who have taken it before you.

Programs

Programs that move careers

Four signature programs, one goal: more women leading Canadian recreation, tourism and hospitality. Members can join any program; scholarships keep cost from being a barrier.

Online · Cohort based

WORTH Academy

An eight week leadership curriculum built for hospitality: people leadership, financial fluency, revenue strategy and executive presence. Two cohorts a year, capped at 40 members each, with a certificate on completion.

Next cohort: February 2 to March 27, 2027 · Member price: $249 (scholarships available)

6 months · Matched pairs

Mentorship Program

Members are matched one to one with senior women leaders matched by sector, region and goals. Structured kickoff, monthly guided conversations and a closing celebration. 340+ matches made to date.

Applications: Winter 2027 cohort closes January 15, 2027 · Cost: included with membership

 
Annual awards

Scholarships & Bursaries

Funding for the training that unlocks the next role: industry certifications, conference attendance, Academy tuition and formal education. Awards from $500 to $5,000, reviewed by a member panel.

2027 cycle: opens March 1, 2027 · 2026 awarded: $62,500 to 28 members

90 minutes · Online & in person

WORTHshops

Short, practical skill sessions led by working leaders: negotiation, personal brand, difficult conversations, financial confidence, and stepping into ownership. Free for members; guests welcome at open sessions.

Coming up: Negotiate With Confidence, Jan 21, 2027

Not a member yet?

Membership is $95/year (students and early career: $45) and includes Mentorship matching, WORTHshop access, the members only Career Hub and chapter events in Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Montréal and Halifax, plus a national online community.

Do I need to be a member to attend events or use resources?

No. Open events and selected resources are free for everyone. Members get priority registration, free WORTHshops, mentorship matching and the full Resource Hub.

Can I apply for a scholarship before joining?

Scholarships are for members, but you can join and apply in the same cycle, membership activates instantly in this demo flow and the scholarship form opens right after.

How does mentorship matching work?

Tell us your sector, region and goals in the application. WORTH pairs you with a senior leader and provides agendas for six monthly conversations.
